text: Self-care is how you take your power back.
author: Lalah Delia

text: Every one of us needs to show how much we care for each other and, in the process, care for ourselves.
author: Princess Diana

text: Have patience with all things. But, first of all with yourself.
author: Francis de Sales

text: Knowing how to be solitary is central to the art of loving. When we can be alone, we can be with others without using them as a means of escape.
author: Bell Hooks

text: It's not selfish to love yourself, take care of yourself, and to make your happiness a priority. It's necessary.
author: Mandy Hale

text: It's good to do uncomfortable things. It's weight training for life.
author: Anne LaMott

text: Self-care has become a new priority—the revelation that it's perfectly permissible to listen to your body and do what it needs.
author: Frances Ryan

text: Aim high and don't sell yourself short.
author: Holly Holm

text: Real women are fat. And thin. And both, and neither and otherwise.
author: Hanne Blank

text: Your worth is not measured by the size of your waist.
author: Unknown

text: You are not a burden. You have a burden, which by definition is too heavy to carry alone.
author: Unknown

text: You, yourself, as much as anybody in the entire universe, deserve your love and affection.
author: Buddha

text: Healing begins when we accept ourselves as we are.
author: Carl Rogers

text: Your value doesn't decrease based on someone's inability to see your worth.
author: Unknown

text: Be kind to yourself, especially when your mind tells you not to be.
author: Unknown

text: You are enough. Not because you did or said or thought or bought or became. You are enough because you always were.
author: Marisa Peer

text: Taking care of yourself doesn't mean me first, it means me too.
author: L.R. Knost

text: You can't pour from an empty cup. Take care of yourself first.
author: Unknown

text: Almost everything will work again if you unplug it for a few minutes…including you.
author: Anne Lamott

text: It's not the load that breaks you down, it's the way you carry it.
author: Lena Horne

text: Self-care is not a luxury; it's a necessity.
author: Unknown

text: Rest and self-care are so important. When you take time to replenish your spirit, it allows you to serve others from the overflow.
author: Eleanor Brown

text: You owe yourself the love you so freely give to others.
author: Unknown

text: Caring for myself is not self-indulgence. It is self-preservation.
author: Audre Lorde

text: Give yourself permission to rest. You don't have to be everything to everyone.
author: Unknown

text: You are not too much. You have never been too much. You will never be too much. The ones who can't handle you are simply not enough.
author: Unknown

text: Your existence alone makes this world a better place. Remember that on the hard days.
author: Unknown

text: You don't need to earn your worth. You were born worthy.
author: Brené Brown

text: The relationship you have with yourself sets the tone for every other relationship in your life.
author: Robert Holden

text: Stop looking for happiness in the same place you just lost it.
author: Unknown

text: You're allowed to outgrow people who don't grow with you.
author: Unknown

text: Darling, you are not a backup plan. You are worth more than someone's second choice.
author: Unknown

text: The most powerful relationship you will ever have is the relationship with yourself.
author: Steve Maraboli

text: I am not what happened to me. I am what I choose to become.
author: Carl Jung

text: You've been criticizing yourself for years and it hasn't worked. Try approving of yourself and see what happens.
author: Louise Hay

text: Your worth is not determined by your productivity. You are valuable simply because you exist.
author: Unknown

text: Someday you'll look back and realize that the version of you struggling right now was actually the bravest you've ever been.
author: Unknown

text: You deserve someone who is terrified to lose you. Not someone who makes you feel like you're asking for too much.
author: Unknown

text: The moment you feel like you have to prove your worth to someone is the moment to absolutely and utterly walk away.
author: Alysia Harris

text: Talk to yourself like you would to someone you love.
author: Brené Brown

text: You are allowed to be both a masterpiece and a work in progress simultaneously.
author: Sophia Bush

text: Your healing is not a performance for others. Take all the time you need.
author: Unknown

text: You are not required to set yourself on fire to keep other people warm.
author: Unknown

text: Be gentle with yourself. You're doing the best you can with what you know right now.
author: Unknown

text: Never apologize for having high standards. People who really want to be in your life will rise up to meet them.
author: Ziad K. Abdelnour

text: You were not born to just pay bills and die. You were born to live.
author: Unknown

text: Your mental health is more important than their expectations. Your peace is more important than their opinion.
author: Unknown

text: The way you speak to yourself matters. Be kind, be patient, be loving.
author: Unknown

text: I hope you know that you are good enough. Actually, you're more than enough. You're extraordinary.
author: Unknown

text: You are worthy of love and belonging. Not when you accomplish something, not when you lose weight, not when you get that job. Right now. As you are.
author: Unknown

text: Stop shrinking yourself to make others comfortable. Your light is meant to shine.
author: Unknown

text: You don't have to be perfect to be worthy of love, respect, and kindness—especially from yourself.
author: Unknown

text: Your past mistakes do not define your future worth. You are always deserving of another chance.
author: Unknown

text: You are not difficult to love. You just haven't found someone who knows how to love you properly yet.
author: Unknown

text: Self-compassion is simply giving the same kindness to ourselves that we would give to others.
author: Christopher Germer

text: You are not behind in life. Your timing is unique to you and your journey.
author: Unknown

text: The person you're becoming will cost you people, relationships, and material things. Choose her anyway.
author: Unknown

text: Your needs are not an inconvenience. Your feelings are not a burden. You matter.
author: Unknown

text: You deserve love that is soft, patient, and kind. Don't settle for anything less.
author: Unknown

text: It's okay if all you did today was survive. That's enough. You are enough.
author: Unknown

text: You are not broken. You are breaking through.
author: Alex Elle

text: Remember: someone else's beauty doesn't diminish your own. There's room for all of us to shine.
author: Unknown

text: You have survived 100% of your worst days. You're doing better than you think.
author: Unknown

text: Your value doesn't lie in what you do or what you achieve. Your value lies in who you are.
author: Unknown

text: You are not asking for too much. You're just asking the wrong people.
author: Unknown

text: Please be gentle with yourself. You're meeting versions of yourself you never knew existed.
author: Unknown

text: You don't need to justify your existence. You are here, and that is your birthright.
author: Unknown

text: Stop waiting for someone to save you. Be your own hero.
author: Unknown

text: You are the only person who will be with you for your entire life. Make sure you're someone you love spending time with.
author: Unknown

text: Your worth is inherent. It cannot be earned, lost, or taken away. It simply is.
author: Unknown
